text_block_list.name: Taishin & Royce
text_block_list.text:
Featuring Royce and Narita Taishin... it's 
"Delish-uma☆Chat Cooking"~~♪

—It happened a few hours ago. Today was a 
rest day. As I walked through town 
wondering if Narita Taishin was managing 
to refresh herself...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were good at games, but... to 
this extent?! Why don't you use this as a 
selling point?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No... what do you mean, 'selling 
point'...?
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! Hey Taishin-san, what 
else can you do? Hobbies? Special skills? 
Favorite things? Go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I told you, you don't have to answer!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe, I'm starting to get the 
picture. Hey, you two, why don't you team 
up with me? To boost our publicity 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, on today's stream, we've invited 
Taishin-san, who's been drawing lots of 
attention for running in the Triple Crown 
races☆”

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come on, smile, smile! You agreed that 
'getting known comes first' if you want to 
prove everyone wrong, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's no reason to act all 
fake-cute. I'm just gonna be myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next... Peel the potatoes while 
they're hot. Remove the sprouts, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Teacher Taishin! Alright, Royce is 
gonna do this~♪ ...Kyaah, hot-hot-hot! 
Tee-hee☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I'll go ahead and sauté the 
chopped onions and ground meat over here."

Contrary to expectations, Narita Taishin 
kept moving forward smoothly. And Royce 
and Royce continued to skillfully liven up 
the conversation while keeping her hands 
busy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright! So about the croquettes we're 
making today... They're surprisingly 
tricky to cook, aren't they~? Do you make 
them often, Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... If I make something simple, it's 
over in a flash. Cooking is just how I 
kill time on days off, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So you deliberately chose something 
time-consuming? Aside from cooking, what 
other hobbies do you have? Everyone wants 
to know too, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so curious~~!" "What do you do on 
your days off?" "Is it true you like video 
games?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I play games pretty often... 
Lately, fantasy MMORPGs and stuff. Mostly 
solo, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And after that... I'll just sleep in my 
room. It's way more fun than wandering 
around for nothing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
In short... I'm an indoor person and don't 
really have any grand hobbies. They're all 
just ways to kill time...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That sounds totally fine! I actually love 
that kind of thing♪ Oh, I know! How about 
taking a nap in the shade together 
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's where you're supposed to say 
"I'd love to!"

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comment
text_block_list.text:
"lololol turf" "Taking a nap together, are 
they grade schoolers?!" "Taishin's salty 
reaction is the best"
choice_data_list:
(I was on edge for a second, but... it's a 
hit! Nice!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Taste-testing tiiime!! *blow* *blow*, 
*crunch*... Wh-What is this...!?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That was so good~~! Chunky minced 
meat♪ The texture of the coarsely mashed 
potatoes is simply irresistible...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating... It's fine since 
it's freshly fried, but the batter might 
get soggy once it cools down... Hmm, maybe 
the oil wasn't hot enough for the second 
fry?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I can make this taste a little better.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, as expected of you. 
Taishin-san, despite having such a 
brilliant racing career, you still strive 
to improve at cooking too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that's all for this stream☆ 
Look forward to the future of this 
multifaceted girl full of dreams! See you 
next time~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what was that last part? It's not 
like I have a ton of hobbies, and what do 
you mean 'full of dreams'?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? "Making it 
taste a little better" is a dream in its 
own right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No way. That's impossible. I... my dream, 
it's..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just delivering results in races. That's 
all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? Doesn't look that way to me, 
though."
